jurisdiction_name: WEST JEFFERSON WARD3 (WEST JEFFERSON VILLAGE Village)
narrative: West Jefferson Ward3 (Village of West Jefferson Village) has 639 registered voters, with 60.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 26.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 12.7%, a pronounced Republican lean of 13.8 percentage points.
